About
The Surgeon

Dr. Arun GR is a fellowship-trained orthopaedic surgeon, trained in India and the UK. His areas of focus include arthritis, sports injuries, fractures, shoulder and knee problems, arthroplasty and arthroscopy.

  • MBBS
  • MS (Orthopaedics)
  • FASM
  • Fellowship in Shoulder Arthroscopy and Joint Replacement Surgery (DePuy-Mitek)
  • British Elbow and Shoulder Society Fellowship, Liverpool, UK

Jewel ACL
Precision ACL Reconstruction

A patient-specific approach to ACL reconstruction, aimed at restoring knee function and long-term stability.

  • Anatomical reconstruction
  • Tissue preservation
  • Customized graft selection
  • Restoration of natural knee biomechanics
